# sh-alert

**Purpose:** message that stays until resolved or dismissed. Style Inline = card inside the page ("Complete your profile"); Banner = edge-to-edge strip under the app header for app-wide status ("You are offline", "Payment failed"). Type Information / Success / Warning / Error; title, body, optional action and close.

**Keywords:** alert, banner, alert banner, inline message, notice, callout, warning, error, offline

Core · 8 variants · [Open in Figma](https://www.figma.com/design/l1SuD1Q1l8QXGvtomszGYW/Shaadi-DNA?node-id=2718-41675) (node `2718:41675`)

## Types

### Style=Inline, Type=Information

**Purpose:** information message card that stays in the page.

### Style=Inline, Type=Success

**Purpose:** success message card that stays in the page.

### Style=Inline, Type=Warning

**Purpose:** warning message card that stays in the page.

### Style=Inline, Type=Error

**Purpose:** error message card that stays in the page.

### Style=Banner, Type=Information

**Purpose:** edge-to-edge information strip under the app header for app-wide or screen-wide status ("You are offline").

### Style=Banner, Type=Success

**Purpose:** edge-to-edge success strip under the app header for app-wide or screen-wide status ("Payment successful").

### Style=Banner, Type=Warning

**Purpose:** edge-to-edge warning strip under the app header for app-wide or screen-wide status ("Plan expires today").

### Style=Banner, Type=Error

**Purpose:** edge-to-edge error strip under the app header for app-wide or screen-wide status ("Payment failed").
